name: S-250 Chela-class starfighter
description: The S-250 Chela-class starfighter was a craft used by the Republic fleet at many battles, including the Battle of Rakata Prime in 3956 BBY. Though a loser in the "Generation Tomorrow Starfighter" competition, it was still purchased in small numbers by the Republic.

data.name: S-250 Chela-class starfighter
data.cost: Not available for sale (estimated value 420,000 credits)
armament: Twin concussion missile launchers (6 missiles each)
